veld-pt-driehoek.uitleg: Pass to the player at the next cone and sprint after your ball to that cone. The receiver takes their first touch towards the next cone and plays on. After a few minutes, change direction.
veld-pt-driehoek.organisatie: Triangle of about 9 m with three disc cones. Two players with the ball at the starting cone, one player at each of the other two.
coachpunten: Receive with your back foot, body open to the next cone
Pass to your teammate's correct foot (the one they want to receive with)
Accelerate straight after your pass

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Add a second ball
Receive with the outside of the foot

veld-pt-y-vorm.uitleg: A passes to B, B lays it back and A plays it long to C (left) or D (right). Then rotate: A to B's spot, B to C, C dribbles back to the start. The next round goes to the other side.
veld-pt-y-vorm.organisatie: Start cone A; B 7 m straight ahead; C and D 6 m further on, 5 m to the left and right (Y-shape). Start with 4–6 players; extra players wait at A.
coachpunten: B: move away from the cone first, then come short to receive
Lay it back onto A's running foot so they can play it first time
Long pass firm and in front of the receiver

makkelijker: B controls first and then passes back
moeilijker: Everything one-touch
C/D also lays it back to B arriving (third man)
Two balls: left and right alternately
After the lay-off, C plays B in behind and B finishes on the big goal

veld-pt-rebounder.uitleg: Pass against the rebounder (or a wall) and move sideways while the ball is travelling. Control the return with the inside of your foot and play it back with the other foot. That way you shuttle between two spots.
veld-pt-rebounder.organisatie: Rebounder or wall 7 m away. Two disc cones 4 m apart mark the width. One player per rebounder; with more players, take turns of 30 seconds.
coachpunten: Be balanced every time before you receive the ball
Inside of the foot, ankle locked, standing foot next to the ball
Alternate left and right foot

makkelijker: Stay in one spot, 4 m away
moeilijker: Play it back first time
10 m away and harder
After each pass, turn round a cone behind you
After three passes, take the ball and score in a mini goal

veld-pt-lange-bal.uitleg: A plays a long, lofted ball to B in the area on the other side. B controls it out of the air, takes it with them inside the area and plays it long back. A ball that lands in the area scores a point. Suitable from U13.
veld-pt-lange-bal.organisatie: Two 6 × 6 m areas 25 m apart (15–20 m for younger players). One player in each area; with more players, queues behind the areas.
coachpunten: Standing foot beside and slightly behind the ball, strike the bottom of it with your laces
Lean back slightly and follow through towards your target
Receiver: read the flight early and take it in your running direction

moeilijker: Distance 30–35 m
First touch straight out of the area (take it with you)
Cross-field ball: from the side to a player making a run

veld-pt-poortjesspel.uitleg: Pairs pass the ball to each other through a gate: every good pass through a gate is a point. Then you have to pick a different gate. Which pair has the most points after 1.5 minutes?
veld-pt-poortjesspel.organisatie: 18 × 17 m area with 5 gates of two disc cones (1.5 m wide). Pairs with one ball; all pairs play at the same time.
coachpunten: Off the ball: move to the other side of a free gate in good time
On the ball: look up and pick a gate where your partner is already waiting
Pass firmly and along the ground

makkelijker: The same gate twice is allowed
moeilijker: Two touches maximum
A tagger or defender who can intercept passes
Pass with the weaker foot only
After passing through the gate, keep running: your partner plays it back into your path

veld-pt-vierhoek-twee-ballen.uitleg: Four players on the corners of a square, two balls on opposite corners. Both balls go round at the same time: receive with your back foot towards the next corner and play on. On the whistle, the direction changes.
veld-pt-vierhoek-twee-ballen.organisatie: 10 × 10 m square with a cone on each corner. Players stand just inside the cone. Two balls with players on opposite corners.
coachpunten: Stay open: body facing the ball and the next corner
Receive with your back foot, in one movement onto your passing foot
Watch the second ball: talk and play in time

moeilijker: One-touch passing
Follow your pass to the next corner
Add a third ball

veld-cv-derde-man-afronden.uitleg: Player 1 passes into player 2, who comes short and lays it back. Meanwhile player 3 (the third man) runs in behind the defender. Player 1 plays them in first time and player 3 finishes.
veld-cv-derde-man-afronden.organisatie: Triangle of about 8 m, 20–28 m from goal, mannequin as a defender at 15 m. Rotate after each attack: 1 becomes 2, 2 becomes 3, 3 joins the ball.
coachpunten: Player 2: come short and lay it back first time
Third man: only start when the ball reaches player 2, then go flat out
Through ball into the run, not to feet

makkelijker: Player 3 starts before the first pass
moeilijker: A defender instead of the mannequin
Everything one-touch
After the shot, player 1 defends a second attack

veld-pt-y-vorm-varianten.uitleg: The Y-shape, three times with a different finish. Variation 1, overlap: the starter passes into the lay-off player, gets it back, plays to the left and runs round the outside of the left-hand player, who plays it back into their path. Variation 2, third man: the lay-off player knocks it straight out to the left, the starter sprints past the lay-off player in behind and gets the ball as the third man. Variation 3, long ball: lay-off back and then a long ball straight to the end player. Every variation ends with the end player at the top of the Y.
veld-pt-y-vorm-varianten.organisatie: Starters with balls at the bottom of the Y (34 m), lay-off player at 24 m, a player left and right at 16 m (6 m to the side), end player at the top at 4 m. Cones by the lay-off player and the left and right players. After each go, everyone moves on one spot.
coachpunten: Lay-off player: move away from the cone first, then come short and play it first time
Overlap and third man: only go once the ball is travelling, then accelerate flat out
Long ball: standing foot next to the ball, strike through it and aim for the end player’s chest or feet

makkelijker: Practise each variation separately a few times in a row
moeilijker: Everything one-touch
The coach only calls the variation during the first pass
Right instead of left, or alternate

veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.naam: Rebounder, turn and finish in a mini goal
veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.uitleg: The player passes against the rebounder twice, takes the second return with a turn away from the rebounder, dribbles to one of the two mini goals and scores.
veld-cv-rebounder-doeltjes.organisatie: Rebounder (or wall) 4 m from the player. Two mini goals 8 m behind them, left and right. The coach (or a teammate) calls which goal.
coachpunten: Pass with the inside of the foot, ankle locked
First touch on the turn: body open, take the ball towards the goal's side
Finish: place it, don't blast it

moeilijker: The coach only calls the goal during the first touch
A defender starts from the rebounder
Pass with left and right alternately

veld-tq-gerichte-aanname-voren.uitleg: The defender plays the ball into the midfielder, who has their back to goal and an opponent (mannequin) behind them. The midfielder receives on the open side and turns forwards with that first touch, away from the mannequin. Then they play straight into the striker, who finishes.
veld-tq-gerichte-aanname-voren.organisatie: On half a pitch. Defender with balls 44 m from goal, midfielder at 32 m with a mannequin diagonally behind them, striker at 22 m. Keeper in goal. Rotate after each go: defender → midfielder → striker → defender.
coachpunten: Check over your shoulder before receiving: where is the mannequin, where is the striker?
Stand half-turned and receive on your back foot
Your first touch already goes forwards: no extra touch needed

moeilijker: A real opponent instead of the mannequin
Play the striker in first time after the turn
The defender’s pass comes in the air

veld-pt-ruit-derde-man.uitleg: Four players in a diamond. The bottom player plays the ball into the top player, who comes short. They lay it off first time to the player on the side, who has come inside. Meanwhile the player on the other side sprints forward as the third man, round the back of the player who laid it off, and receives the through ball in their stride. At the top the pattern turns round and the ball goes back down the same way. Everyone rotates: the player who laid it off takes over the free side.
veld-pt-ruit-derde-man.organisatie: Diamond 18 m long and 12 m wide, with a cone on each point. One player per point, one ball. The ball goes back and forth; after a few minutes let the other side make the forward run, so everyone uses both feet.
coachpunten: Come short the moment the passer looks up, not before
Lay it off first time and onto the right foot: the ball must not stop
Third man: go on the lay-off, so you get the ball in your stride
Play the through ball in front of the runner, so they do not have to slow down

makkelijker: At walking pace first, so everyone knows the runs
moeilijker: Everything one touch
A mannequin or passive defender behind the player laying it off
Two balls at once: one starts at the bottom, one at the top

veld-pt-lange-lijn-kort-lang.naam: Long line: short and long pass
veld-pt-lange-lijn-kort-lang.uitleg: Four players stand on one line. The outside player plays a short pass into the player next to them, gets it back and then plays the long ball over the two in the middle to the player at the other end. They do the same back the other way. After a few goes, the outside and middle players swap places.
veld-pt-lange-lijn-kort-lang.organisatie: Four cones in one line: the outside two 25 m apart, the middle two 8 m from the outside ones. Four players, one ball. Swap places after 2 minutes.
coachpunten: Short pass firm and onto the right foot so the lay-off can be first time
Long ball: standing foot beside the ball, strike under the middle with your instep
Receiver: watch the ball in and cushion it

makkelijker: The long ball may go along the ground
moeilijker: Long ball first time after the lay-off
The middle players move between the outside ones
Receive out of the air with one touch

veld-pt-bewegend-poortje.uitleg: Two players together are a gate: they walk side by side, 2 m apart, slowly around the area. The others pass through the gate in pairs. Every good pass through the gate is a point. Because the gate moves, you have to watch carefully and pick the right moment.
veld-pt-bewegend-poortje.organisatie: 20 × 20 m area. One gate of two players in bibs; the rest in pairs with one ball. Rounds of 1.5 minutes; then another pair becomes the gate.
coachpunten: Watch where the gate is going and pass at the right moment
Pass firmly along the ground with the inside of the foot
After your pass, move straight away to a new space

moeilijker: Two gates
The gate walks faster
One-touch passes only

veld-pt-kaats-wissel-van-kant.uitleg: The defender plays the ball into the striker, who comes short. The striker lays it off first time to the midfielder, who switches play with a long pass to the winger on the other side. The winger takes the ball on the run. Then it starts again, with the ball going the other way.
veld-pt-kaats-wissel-van-kant.organisatie: On half a pitch: defender at 30 m, midfielder at 22 m, striker at 14 m, two wingers wide at 20 m. Five players, two balls. After 4 goes everyone moves on one position.
coachpunten: Striker: come short the moment the defender looks up
Lay it off onto the foot furthest from the striker
Midfielder: stay open so you can switch in one movement

makkelijker: The midfielder may control the ball first
moeilijker: A passive defender behind the striker
Switch first time
The winger finishes on a goal

veld-pt-zeshoek-richting.uitleg: Six players stand at six cones in a hexagon. The ball goes round first time to the next player, clockwise. On the whistle the direction changes: whoever gets the ball then plays it back the other way. Stay ready, because the ball can come from either side.
veld-pt-zeshoek-richting.organisatie: Hexagon with sides of about 6.5 m, a cone on each corner. Six players, one ball; after a minute add a second ball. The coach whistles to change direction.
coachpunten: Stay open to both neighbours so you can go either way
Play with the foot furthest from the ball
Switch straight away on the whistle

moeilijker: Two balls going opposite ways
After your pass, swap places with your neighbour
